title: Every Year One Kid Gets the Weather Umbrella… She Picked RAIN?! ☔
description:
In this town, every year one kid gets the Weather Umbrella — and whatever they wish for falls from the sky! Pizza, candy, puppies… this year it's Mia's turn, and everyone is shouting what they want. But Mia's friend Omar has a farm that hasn't seen rain in years. What will she choose? ☔🌱

A short, kid-friendly story about kindness and thinking of others.

#shorts #animation #kidsstory #storytime #kindness
